checks.description: Install the exact candidate with generated Setup.exe; no manual NETLOAD or substituted DLLs.
AutoCAD discovers QS3D.bundle and the QS3D command lazy-loads the plugin.
QS3D dockable workspace opens without startup/NETLOAD failure.
Record the CLR version observed inside the loaded QS3D plugin and verify it matches the expected host runtime family.
Create/edit Level and verify linked annotation and metadata.
Create/edit Grid, Grid array and dependency/reference operations.

Rename a Level/Grid without changing its semantic GUID or dependent bindings; bulk sequence Levels by elevation; resequence a selected parallel Grid family by spatial order; verify labels, duplicate/collision safety, undo/redo and save/reopen persistence.
Create/edit Column geometry and metadata.
Create/edit Beam geometry and metadata.
Create/edit Slab geometry and metadata.
Create/edit Wall geometry and metadata.
Create/edit Curtain geometry and metadata.
QS3DCOLUMNJIG/QS3DBEAMJIG/QS3DSLABJIG/QS3DWALLJIG/QS3DCURTAINJIG show transient 3D solids or panels that track cursor sampling before commit.

During each JIG drag, transient dimension/orientation text tracks the current cursor-derived geometry: Column W/D/H, Beam/Wall length-section-angle, Slab X/Y/thickness/area, and Curtain length/panel width/angle. The text disappears on cancel/commit and is never stored in DWG metadata.
Cancel/ESC during every JIG command leaves no new DWG entity, QS3D XData, browser row or BOQ quantity.
QS3DGRIDSNAP moves/rebuilds bound structural geometry and metadata together, preserves Level/Z semantics, keeps BOQ aligned, and rejects invalid parallel two-Grid Column intersections.
Create/edit Section marker and linked annotation.
QS3DBOQ counts only QS3D-owned entities and quantities remain aligned with visible geometry.
Drawing pickfirst selection and project browser/property inspector synchronize both directions.
Assign element to Level, move Level, and verify physical geometry plus metadata move together.
Bind/clear Grid references and verify deletion is blocked while dependents remain.
Creation and geometry-safe edits participate correctly in AutoCAD undo/redo.
After save/close/reopen, project XRecord, QS3D XData and Level/Grid references persist.
After restarting AutoCAD, command-invocation autoload still works from the installed bundle.
Setup upgrade preserves/rolls back the installed bundle correctly and the upgraded candidate loads.
Setup --uninstall removes QS3D.bundle and AutoCAD no longer exposes QS3D commands on restart.
QS3D Ribbon tab/panels are present and invoke the intended commands through the installed AutoCAD UI runtime.
Ribbon/workspace is usable at high DPI and AutoCAD light/dark themes on the tested host.
Run QS3DMEPTAKEOFF on representative supported MEP geometry and verify recognition, quantity and unit parity plus fail-closed unsupported or ambiguous handling.
Run QS3DMEPCLASH on representative hard and clearance clash cases and verify deterministic pair, type, severity and geometry classification.

Run QS3DMEPCLASHLOCATE for an exact clash pair and verify PICKFIRST selection; stale, unknown, ambiguous or partially resolved references fail closed without replacing prior valid selection or review state.
Run QS3DMEPEXACTCLASH and verify exact native-geometry clash results against representative known cases.
Run QS3DMEPZOOMSELECTION from representative MEP review selection and verify the intended visible and selected objects in the owning document without unintended selection or state drift.
Open, use and close QS3DMEPREVIEW and the MEP review palette modelessly; verify command parity, focus and lifecycle behavior plus active-document affinity.
Edit and save a MEP recognition profile, restart AutoCAD and verify persistence; corrupt or invalid profile input must fail closed within documented bounds.
With multiple drawings open, verify MEP takeoff, clash, Locate, review and profile operations remain bound to the active or owning document and do not leak selection or results across DWGs.
Verify MEP analysis, review, Locate and profile-read paths do not create or mutate unrelated QS3D semantic project state, DWG entities, XData, XRecords or unintended sidecar/project state.
Installed/tested artifact hashes and exact source SHA match RELEASE-PROVENANCE.json.
